grader.scenario: Mobile eSIM transfer timing out on new iPhone 15; network divert workaround established; 4-5 faults (okay)
grader.notes: Okay call featuring dead air breaches, failed verification and personalization, handled empathy in middle third, call divert workaround, and pending eSIM activation.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net mobile technical services' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Agent allowed two separate unmanaged dead air gaps of 40 seconds at turns 14 and 33.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent failed to ask for address or security PIN during verification.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent never addressed customer as Stefan throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand the acute distress, financial loss, and severe worry you are experiencing...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased the eSIM activation timeout issue at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for mobile number at turn 44 despite customer stating 07700 900742 at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent generated new QR code, guided setup, implemented immediate network call divert, and waived fee.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained polite, helpful, and professional tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent failed to probe regarding error code 503 diagnostics.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: eSIM activation required 30 minutes to 4 hours to propagate; resolution unverified on call despite divert workaround.
